_comment: Behavior-defining TMDb Helper settings applied to every device by the setup service. NO secrets are stored here. Trakt and any API keys are authenticated on-device by the user. Values mirror the scrubbed backup so the For You / calendar behavior matches the original build. trakt_scrobbling is OFF on purpose: Red Light owns scrobbling (see scrobbler_settings.json). With the Red Light auto player TMDb Helper never learns what is playing anyway, and leaving it on would double scrobble if the player ever became resolvable.
